editorial.label: Editorial
editorial.hint: Serif type on a wide scale, a narrow reading column, generous air, quiet surfaces.

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.hint: One sans-serif, a tight scale, even spacing, flat surfaces.

bold.label: Bold
bold.hint: Heavy grotesk headlines, the steepest scale, deep colour and layered depth.

soft.label: Soft
soft.hint: Rounded type, pill shapes, relaxed spacing and soft shadows.

brutalist.label: Brutalist
brutalist.hint: Monospace capitals, hard offset shadows, thick rules and stark colour.
